chunks: They said: 'Let us swear by God that we will attack him and his family at night, and later tell his heir: "We did not see his family destroyed, and we speak the truth."'

key_terms.لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ: We will attack/kill him at night

ai.seo_question: How did the people plan to conceal the murder of Prophet Shu'ayb?
ai.summary: In Surah An-Naml, this verse highlights the strategic cunning of the Banū al-Mustali' as they conspired to assassinate Prophet Shu'ayb (AS) and his family under the cover of darkness. Their plan to swear a solemn oath to the heirs, claiming innocence to maintain credibility, illustrates the theme of *tāqiyya* (strategic dissimulation) and the persistence of deception even in the face of divine truth. This narrative serves as a precursor to the broader story of the Midianites, emphasizing how political expediency often masks moral corruption.
